long_biography.plain_text:
Pierre-Georges Chausson helped turn Chausson Matériaux from a regional merchant into a national construction-supply group. After joining in 1985, he and his brother Philippe shifted the business towards direct branch ownership, stronger logistics and in-house production, while capital transactions protected family control.

Under their leadership, the company combined acquisitions with digital ordering and specialised manufacturing. Pierre-Georges also brought long-term investors into the group to finance consolidation without surrendering managerial autonomy. The later integration of Frans Bonhomme extended Chausson into water, utility and public-works supplies. He chairs Verdale Holding, the family-led company that formally presides over Chausson Matériaux.
